SELECT a.id, a.version, a.number, a.name, a.value, a.description, a.is_system, a.app_id, b.name AS app_name FROM t_sys_param a LEFT JOIN t_sys_app b ON b.id = a.app_id
a.app_id = #{form.appId} b.domain_id = #{form.domainId} a.app_id IS NULL
AND (a.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%') OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY ${listQuery.sortColumn} ${listQuery.sortOrder}, a.id ORDER BY a.number, a.id
